title: Crispy Indian Cabbage Salad
description: A crunchy and flavorful salad with an Indian twist, featuring cabbage, salad, and a hint of herbed spices.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine shredded cabbage and mixed greens.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together herbed oil and salt.
3. Pour the herbed oil mixture over the cabbage mixture and toss to coat.
4. Sprinkle crunchy slaw mix over the top and toss again to combine.
5. Season with black pepper to taste.
6. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
7. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
